baseline_construction_method.value: Energy baselines for thermal and electrical Significant Energy Users were determined using the single (linear) regression method per ISO 50006, regressing energy data (e.g. Kcal coal) on a single production driver (ton clinker, kWh output or ton steam) fitted to 2016 and 2017 monthly data; baseline equations of the form Y = mX + C were accepted once the R-square met the 0.75 minimum.

value: Energy team had to balance ISO 50001 implementation with other primary duties; energy-management tasks are functional and not part of structural job descriptions (organisational).
Reliable energy consumption data is needed to set the performance baseline (data quality).
Increasing the competence of the human resources / energy team through training is necessary (staff skills).
Need to build an IT system and central database for online energy-performance monitoring and record-keeping (IT/software infrastructure).
evidence_quote: the balancing act the energy team had to play between implementing ISO 50001 and their other primary duties/roles
To set a baseline as a comparison of energy performance, reliable energy consumption data is needed
Increasing the competence of human resources / energy teams through training is very necessary
It is important to build an IT system and central data base so that energy performance can be monitored online
